title: RenderingDevice.texture_create cannot create 3d rd textures
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.2.stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Fedora Linux 42 (Workstation Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (NVK GA106) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-11400H @ 2.70GHz (12 threads)

### Issue description

`RenderingDevice.texture_create` is incapable of creating textures with formats `texture_type` set to `RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_TYPE_3D`

As per the documentation on `.depth` and `.array_layers` on `RDTextureFormat`, I would expect to be able to create 3d textures by modifying `.depth` and `texture_type` (see for example the mvp).

Currently, this is impossible, because of the following check in `rendering_device.cpp:957`:
`ERR_FAIL_COND_V_MSG(data.size() != (int)format.array_layers, RID(), // ...`

According to the docs, `array_layers` should only be relevant if the texture type is that of a 2d texture array. This doesn't seem to be the case, what I suspect happens is that the check is performed for all texture types.


The documentation on these things is rather sparse so there's a chance that I'm simply doing something wrong but if that's the case, I think it'd be good to update the docs.


Here's the script from the MVP, for easier access:
```
extends Node

# Texture dimensions
var width = 2
var height = 2
var depth = 2

func _ready():
	var rd = RenderingServer.get_rendering_device()
	
	# Create the format
	var format = RDTextureFormat.new()
	format.width = width
	format.height = height
	format.depth = depth
	if depth == 1:
		format.texture_type = RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_TYPE_2D
	else:
		format.texture_type = RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_TYPE_3D
	format.format = RenderingDevice.DATA_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT
	format.usage_bits = RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_USAGE_CAN_UPDATE_BIT | RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_USAGE_SAMPLING_BIT | RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT | RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_USAGE_CAN_COPY_FROM_BIT

	# Create the view
	var view := RDTextureView.new()

	# Create image layers
	var image_layers = []
	for _i in range(depth):
		var output_image = Image.create(width, height, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBAF)
		image_layers.push_back(output_image.get_data())

	print('attempting to create a texture...')
	var output_texture = rd.texture_create(format, view, image_layers) # <- this line fails!
	print('the line above this one shouldnt have errored out')
	print('result: ', output_texture) # outputs RID(0)
```

### Steps to reproduce

Open the mvp, run the project with the default scene, notice the error message.
Code is in the only gdscript file,
